info.name: Fun API — fun.idigital-cs.com
info.description:
Laravel Sanctum API for the Fun community events platform.

1. Set `baseUrl` (default https://fun.idigital-cs.com/api).
2. Run **Auth → Login** (token is saved automatically).
3. Use Bearer `{{token}}` on protected routes.

Seeded admin (if present): admin@example.com / password

request.description: Public display_name + logo_url for Flutter splash/auth.

Sends 4-digit reset code if the email exists.
Change name/email/password. For photo use multipart with `photo`. Email change requires re-verify.
Full parity payload: needs_upload, resubmit_required, documents[3] with url/uploaded flags.
multipart: id_front, id_back, selfie. Returns full identity payload + activated user.
